title.zh: 值得 follow 的开源开发者 · 第一期

intro.zh: GitHub 的 follow 流早就被机器人和刷量账号淹没了。这份名单只收真人、只收正在持续产出的账号：每个人都经过引擎六维评分，段位和分数就摆在推荐语旁边。
intro.en: The GitHub follow feed drowned in bots and farmed accounts long ago. This list admits only real humans with sustained output: every account is scored across six engine dimensions, with tier and score right next to the blurb.

blurb.zh: PSPDFKit 创始人，如今全职做开源 AI 助理。二十年 iOS 生态积累 + 极高强度的当下产出，是"老将转身做 AI"的最佳样本。
blurb.en: Founder of PSPDFKit, now full-time on an open-source AI assistant. Twenty years of iOS ecosystem work plus ferocious current output — the best example of a veteran pivoting to AI.

blurb.zh: Dify 联合创始人兼核心架构师。在一个 9 万 star 的项目里依然保持第一梯队的提交密度，工程判断力在 LLM 平台赛道里数一数二。
blurb.en: Co-founder and core architect of Dify. Still ships in the top tier of commit density on a 96k-star project — engineering judgment among the best in the LLM platform lane.

blurb.zh: Follow 客户端核心贡献者，前端工具链方向的高产选手。典型的"低调但处处可见"型账号：你大概率用过他参与的东西而不自知。
blurb.en: Core contributor to the Follow client and a prolific frontend-tooling builder. The classic quietly-everywhere account: you've probably used something he touched without knowing.

blurb.zh: 跨社区"修补匠"的代表：Rust、Python、前端仓库里都能看到他的 PR。单看任何一个项目都不起眼，合起来是惊人的贡献广度——这正是引擎参与度维度想奖励的类型。
blurb.en: The archetypal cross-community fixer: his PRs show up in Rust, Python, and frontend repos alike. Unremarkable in any single project, staggering in aggregate breadth — exactly what the engine's engagement dimension rewards.

blurb.zh: Dify 插件系统与沙箱的主要作者。年轻、产出集中在硬核基建方向，是我们扫描 Dify 团队时分数上升最快的账号。
blurb.en: Primary author of Dify's plugin system and sandbox. Young, focused on hardcore infrastructure, and the fastest-rising score in our scan of the Dify team.
